text:
Maya: quick help — service started via systemd keeps getting 401 from the Redwood API. Works locally. I construct Basic header in Go:
```
auth := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY") + ":"))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic "+auth)
```
But when running under systemd the header seems wrong. Any quick checks?

Oliver: most likely trailing newline/CRLF in the env secret. Quick debug: print quoted value in Go to see hidden chars: `fmt.Printf(%q, os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))` — that will show `\n` or `\r` if present. Also `echo -n` vs `echo` matters.

Maya: ah nice — how to check on the machine?

Oliver: `printf '%s' "$REDWOOD_API_KEY" | xxd -g 1 -u` shows bytes, or `echo -n "$REDWOOD_API_KEY" | wc -c` vs `echo "$REDWOOD_API_KEY" | wc -c` to detect extra newline. For base64 header sanity:
```
# correct way in shell
curl -H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n "$REDWOOD_API_KEY:" | base64)" https://api.redwood.example/v1/health
```
If that returns 200 then your key/encoding is good.

Sam: another common gotcha: GH Actions / CI sometimes injects a trailing newline when you do `echo "$SECRET" > file` without `-n`. Also Windows line endings can sneak in if someone copied from Notepad. `tr -d '\r' < secretfile > clean` or `dos2unix` helps.

Maya: running `printf '%s' "$REDWOOD_API_KEY" | base64` locally returns same as systemd output though…

Jen: check for BOM (utf-8 BOM 0xEF 0xBB 0xBF) too — editors can add it. `xxd` will show EF BB BF at start. In Go you can defensively strip with `bytes.TrimPrefix([]byte(s), []byte{0xEF,0xBB,0xBF})` but better to remove at source.

Maya: printed with `%q` and I see `"mykey\n"` — yep newline. Systemd unit file uses `EnvironmentFile=/etc/default/myservice` which had the key exported with a trailing newline.

Sam: quick fix — change export to `REDWOOD_API_KEY="$(cat /run/secret/redwood)"` and ensure the secret file has no newline, or `REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(tr -d '\r\n' < /run/secret/redwood)`.

Oliver: alternatively, in code do `key := strings.TrimRight(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), "\r\n")` while you fix the provisioning. But mark it tech debt.

Maya: thanks — fixed the EnvironmentFile and the health curl now returns 200.

Jen: small note for future: to generate Basic header explicitly in Go without mistakes: `auth := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s:", key)))` then `req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic "+auth)` — same as you had but ensure `key` is trimmed.

Sam: leaving a tiny snippet for CI that helped us: `echo -n "${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY }}" | base64` — avoids accidental newline. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: pinned link to devex/faq-auth (internal) — mention if you want a short blurb added to quickstart.

Maya: can someone add a one-liner to the README about "ensure secrets have no trailing newline / CRLF"? I'll submit a PR. :raised_hands:
